codes.boundary_wrong: Cut starts or ends in the wrong place; a qualification or setup is lost
codes.needs_context: Not understandable without earlier or later material
codes.unclear: Muddled, rambling or hard to follow
codes.factual_risk: Contains claims that are wrong, unverifiable or easily misread
codes.overclaim: Editorial treatment strengthens an opinion or forecast into a fact
codes.rights_risk: Rights basis or attribution is doubtful for this excerpt
codes.too_long: Would not hold attention at this length
codes.too_short: Not enough substance for a standalone clip
codes.duplicate: Same moment as another candidate already kept
codes.poor_audio: Audio quality or transcription errors make it unusable
codes.other: Anything else; a note is required
